Welcome to Manila's Blindsided 2024! This competition features the events **3x3, 3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, and Square-1**, with **Square-1** as the main event.

For ALL Blindfolded Solvers, **ALL BLD events will start at 9:00 AM and end at 11:30 AM**. [Please refer to the Blindfolded Events Tab for more information.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManilasBlindsided2024#47442-important-blindfolded-events)

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.
